items.q: Shad Collins -- Shad Collins -- he and I got established in something else.

ctx.x: And Shad Collins -- Shad Collins -- he and I got established in something else. Shad was something else. Shad, Shad, he went -- he was -- unto his passport -- we, see, you look at your birth certificate and said, do I fit into this bracket.
For example, when the man called you for service, you 1909? Well, you don't fit in this bracket.
